claims.statement: Industrial vacancy in the Meridian Corridor was 4.1% as of the second quarter of 2025, down from 5.6% a year earlier.

citations.quote:
Industrial vacancy within the Meridian Corridor fell to 4.1% as of the second quarter of 2025,
down from 5.6% a year earlier, on net absorption of approximately 1.9 million square feet
against 1.2 million square feet of new deliveries.
